use(store) benchmark results

Every result for every variant, with and without the React Compiler, one table per suite. The benchmark report explains what they mean.

Measured on React 0.0.0-experimental-a3d8e745-20261101 (a3d8e745), compiler c59ecf06d45b47db, results pinned 2026-11-02.

  • Main suite
  • Memory
  • Typing
  • Typing with useDeferredValue
  • Without the same-element bailout
  • Every Redux setup
  • Derived selectors
  • More readers of derived data
  • Sweeps
  • Rapid dispatch
  • Many components, one counter
  • Deep tree

Main suite

A list of rows with a selection, a filter, and rows that expand to show details. Each scenario times one kind of update at 100 / 1,000 / 10,000 rows, with no CPU slowdown and with a four times CPU slowdown.

What this means →

Duration in milliseconds ± 95% confidence interval (Slowdown = duration / fastest with the same compiler setting)

Lower is better. Click a benchmark name to sort the columns by it, and again to reset. Press compare under a column to test every other column against it. Scroll sideways to see every implementation.
